title: Migration backlog
description: Output of the Assess agent: one item per legacy proc to migrate. Written by the coordinator on behalf of the (readonly) Assess subagent.

item_id.description: Stable ID for this backlog item (e.g. 'item-001').

classification.description: get = returns result set; migrate = INSERT/UPDATE into Dimension table; other = helper.

reads.description: Comma-separated source tables the proc reads from.

writes.description: Comma-separated target tables the proc writes to (empty for get).

target_path.description: Repo-relative path of the converted notebook, e.g. 'databricks/gold/30_mart_daily_sales.sql'.
